name: Claim list (bring list, chores)
use_when: a list of things that each need someone: potluck, bring list, packing, chores, errands
'who's bringing what', 'what do we need', 'split up the chores'
items were named in the chat
dont_use_when: chores handed out at random, a chore wheel (use assign)
seats or spots in a fixed grid (use slots)
guarantees: no item gets more people than it needs
no one takes an item twice or goes over the per-person limit
done items have someone on them; only a taker marks an item done
a leaver's claims open up again; a late joiner can take an item at once

title.description: Card title, e.g. 'What's everyone bringing?' or 'Chores this week'

items.description: Items from the chat, up to 12

perPerson.description: Most items one person can take, 0 for no limit

allowAdd.description: true if people can add items

checkable.description: true for chores or tasks that get done; false for a bring list
